description: Add-to-Cart button not detectable via standard selectors
evidence: Playwright query_selector returned None for all standard ATC selectors: button[name='add'], .btn-addtocart, #AddToCart, [data-action='add-to-cart'], button.product-form__submit
reproduction_steps: Navigate to product page; Inspect DOM for button[name='add'] and common ATC selectors
customer_impact: Customer cannot add product; potential 100% cart abandonment if ATC is non-functional
recommended_fix: Verify button markup and ensure standard name/data attributes are present; inspect for non-standard implementation
validation_method: Manual DOM inspection in Chrome DevTools; automated selector audit

description: Add-to-Cart button requires scrolling on desktop (potentially below the fold)
evidence: ATC button detected beyond initial viewport at 1440x900; exact Y position depends on page content length
reproduction_steps: Load product page at 1440x900; observe initial visible area without scrolling
customer_impact: Users who do not scroll may miss the primary purchase CTA; higher abandonment for passive browsers
recommended_fix: Reposition ATC button above the fold or add a sticky purchase bar at the top or bottom of the viewport
validation_method: A/B test sticky vs. inline CTA on scroll depth and add-to-cart rate; heatmap scroll depth analysis

description: No visible cart feedback / drawer detected immediately after ATC click
evidence: After clicking ATC button, no cart drawer or notification appeared within 2s in automated test
reproduction_steps: Navigate to product page; Click Add to Cart button; Observe cart feedback within 2 seconds
customer_impact: Customer unsure if product was added; may click multiple times or abandon checkout flow
recommended_fix: Implement cart drawer with immediate visual feedback on ATC including item name/price/quantity and proceed-to-checkout CTA
validation_method: A/B test cart drawer vs. cart-page redirect on ATC conversion and repeat-click rate; session recording analysis

description: ATC button click may not be interactable (timeout or element not accessible)
evidence: Playwright click() raised TimeoutError on ATC element during automated test
reproduction_steps: Navigate to product page; Attempt to click ATC button; Observe timeout or non-response
customer_impact: Customer cannot add product to cart; critical conversion blocker
recommended_fix: Debug button z-index, overlapping elements, or JS event handler issues; check for covered elements
validation_method: Reproduce manually in Chrome DevTools; check for covered elements using DevTools element picker

description: Shipping cost and delivery time not prominently displayed on product page
evidence: Body text search for 'free shipping' / 'delivery' on product page returned no match near ATC button area
reproduction_steps: Load product page; search page for shipping information near Add-to-Cart area without scrolling
customer_impact: Customer uncertain about total cost; price anxiety is the #1 cart abandonment reason (Baymard Institute)
recommended_fix: Add shipping information near ATC button: 'Free shipping on orders over [threshold] | Delivered in [X] days'
validation_method: Heatmap analysis of where users leave the page; exit survey on checkout abandonment; A/B test trust strip

description: Return / refund policy not visible on product page
evidence: Body text search for 'return' / 'refund' on product page returned no match
reproduction_steps: Load product page; search page for returns information
customer_impact: Customer risk aversion increases without clear returns policy; first-time buyers may not convert
recommended_fix: Add a brief returns guarantee near ATC: '30-day money-back guarantee | No questions asked'
validation_method: Exit survey asking customers why they did not purchase; A/B test guarantee badge on new-visitor conversion

description: Add-to-Cart button is below the fold on mobile (390x844)
evidence: ATC button Y position exceeds mobile viewport height of 844px at 390x844 viewport
reproduction_steps: Load product page on mobile (390x844); do not scroll; observe ATC button visibility
customer_impact: Mobile users (likely majority of traffic in India) may miss CTA without scrolling; requires effort to find purchase button
recommended_fix: Implement sticky bottom bar on mobile that remains fixed at bottom of viewport showing price and ATC button
validation_method: A/B test sticky mobile CTA bar vs. current layout on mobile add-to-cart rate

description: Multiple interactive elements have touch targets smaller than 44x44px
evidence: Playwright bounding box check on first 20 interactive elements found multiple < 44px in either dimension
reproduction_steps: Load product page on mobile; inspect button/link bounding boxes via DevTools
customer_impact: Difficult tap interactions on mobile; accidental mis-taps reduce usability and increase frustration
recommended_fix: Increase minimum touch target size to 44x44px for all interactive elements (CSS: min-height/min-width: 44px)
validation_method: Automated Playwright bounding-box regression test; manual testing on real iOS and Android devices

description: Body/description text font-size may be below 16px on mobile
evidence: CSS computed style inspection on mobile detected font-size potentially below 16px minimum recommended for mobile
reproduction_steps: Load product page on mobile; inspect body text font size via Chrome DevTools computed styles
customer_impact: Small text increases cognitive load and reduces product comprehension on mobile; affects product understanding
recommended_fix: Set minimum body font size to 16px on mobile viewports
validation_method: Accessibility audit with Lighthouse; user reading comprehension test with 5 participants

description: Product images may lack descriptive alt text
evidence: DOM query detected images with empty or missing alt attribute (illustrative count — requires manual verification)
reproduction_steps: Load product page; DevTools: document.querySelectorAll('img') and inspect alt attributes
customer_impact: Screen reader users receive no product image context; WCAG 1.1.1 violation
recommended_fix: Add descriptive alt text to all product images (e.g. 'Korean Marine Collagen Peptides 100g pouch front view')
validation_method: Automated axe-core scan; manual screen-reader test with NVDA or VoiceOver

description: Form inputs may lack accessible labels
evidence: DOM inspection found inputs without associated <label for=> or aria-label attributes
reproduction_steps: Load product page; DevTools: inspect input elements for label associations
customer_impact: Screen reader users cannot identify form fields; WCAG 1.3.1 violation
recommended_fix: Associate all inputs with visible labels or aria-label attributes
validation_method: axe-core automated test; NVDA/JAWS screen reader test

description: Subscription vs one-time purchase option clarity may be insufficient
evidence: Cannot confirm from automated inspection whether subscribe/one-time selector is visually prominent and clearly labeled; requires manual review
reproduction_steps: Navigate to product page; look for subscription purchase option; assess visual hierarchy and clarity
customer_impact: Customers confused about recurring billing may abandon purchase or later dispute charges; subscription customers have higher LTV
recommended_fix: If subscription option exists: clearly differentiate with visual hierarchy, save percentage, and cancellation terms
validation_method: User testing with 5 participants asking 'What are your purchase options?'; session recording analysis

description: Lack of urgency or scarcity signals may reduce impulse purchases
evidence: No 'low stock' counter, countdown timer, or limited-time offer was detected (assumption: these do not exist; requires manual verification)
reproduction_steps: Load product page; look for stock counter
confidence: Customers without urgency signals may delay purchase decision and not return; estimated industry impact but unverified for this site
recorded_at: Test adding authentic urgency signals (only if factually accurate): stock level indicator or limited-time offer badge
column13: A/B test urgency signals on product-page-to-cart conversion; requires honest data only — never fabricate scarcity

description: Mobile traffic constitutes the majority of product page visits
evidence: Industry average for Indian e-commerce is 70%+ mobile (Source: Statista India E-commerce Report 2025); unverified for this specific site
reproduction_steps: Retrieve device breakdown from GA4 or analytics platform
customer_impact: Determines priority of mobile-first CRO interventions
recommended_fix: Confirm with Wellbeing Nutrition's GA4 device breakdown data before prioritising mobile-only changes
validation_method: Request device split report from company analytics team

description: The product page is the primary conversion bottleneck vs. other funnel stages
evidence: Without funnel analytics, it is assumed the product page has the highest drop-off; checkout or cart abandonment may be greater
reproduction_steps: Request funnel analysis from Wellbeing Nutrition showing drop-off at each stage
customer_impact: Determines whether product page or checkout optimisation should be prioritised
recommended_fix: Confirm with GA4 funnel exploration report showing product page → cart → checkout → purchase drop-off rates
validation_method: Request funnel report from company analytics team
